cases.purpose: Three distinct call slots open and partially close one exact temporary obligation before terminal assessment settlement and reconciliation.
An empty session can settle the zero assessment and enter reconciliation without a target call or protected movement.
A non-participant cannot propose a segment.
A segment cannot call an undeclared target.
A stale claimed prior transcript digest rejects before execution.
Cumulative target calls cannot exceed the authenticated limit.
A protected Observation must come from a target called in the same segment.
A segment cannot claim a phase other than the current transcript phase.
An allocated closure cannot exceed the realized return or opened obligation.
Every closure must repeat the exact immutable Obligation Key.
A closure after its exact close-by segment ordinal is rejected.
Reconciliation cannot begin while any exact obligation amount remains.
An Engine Target must use its participant's exact effective Engine Revision.
A protected profile component must be an exact immutable Core-deployment-pinned participant component.
The programmable.core identifier is reserved from participant identity.
The programmable.core identifier is reserved from target identity.
A protected Observation Domain Revision must be admitted for its exact participant.
An Obligation Key cannot consume a Scope absent from the Session Descriptor.
The normalized movement flag cannot hide a protected movement.
A normalized segment with an Observation cannot declare zero observed bytes.
A protected Effect occurrence ID is unique across the entire session.
A target call slot is consumed once unless a future explicit repeated-call profile says otherwise.
An OPEN must bind one fresh protected Effect occurrence in the same segment.
An outflow Observation must bind the exact protected source actor.
An outflow Observation must bind the exact obligated destination.
A return Observation must come from the exact obligated actor.
A return Observation must reach the exact protected return recipient.
The final checkpoint cannot change settlement completed before reconciliation.
The direct AUTHENTICATED to RECONCILING path is available only to an empty session.
The proposer payload and protected Effect proposal are separate commitments.
The final checkpoint must cover every authenticated participant exactly once.
Declared observed-byte use must equal the independent Core-runtime copied-byte measurement.
Declared return-byte use must equal the independent Core-runtime copied-byte measurement.
An OPEN operation must resolve its actual protected opening Effect record.
An Obligation Key must match its protected opening Effect Authorization Scope.
An Obligation Key must match its protected opening Effect Domain Revision.
An Obligation Key must match its protected opening Effect Asset Profile.
An Obligation Key must match its protected opening Effect native asset.
An Obligation Key must match its protected opening Effect obligated actor.
An Obligation Key must match its protected opening Effect return recipient.
An Obligation Key must match its protected opening Effect gross-debit amount.
A self-consistent opening Effect, key, and Observation still reject an obligated actor absent from participant admission.
A self-consistent opening Effect, key, and Observation still reject a return recipient absent from participant admission.
A protected component revision admitted for one profile cannot be substituted under another component profile.
A direct empty-session reconciliation cannot report target-return bytes when no target was called.
